title: Revision entity relationships
responsibility: Finds categorized dependencies, consumers and containing pages within an active revision registry.

inputs.name: explorerRelations.head
inputs.description: Revision providing active unit definitions and dependency edges.

inputs.name: explorerRelations.id
inputs.description: Entity identifier whose relationships should be traversed.

outputs.name: explorerRelations
outputs.description: Categorized dependencies, non-page users, containing pages and support units. Traversal stops at categorized entities but passes through support units; containing pages are reached upward to any depth. Cycles and duplicate visits are bounded by identifier sets. Missing or inactive identifiers return empty groups.
